mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_date, status, fine_amount, renew_count) SELECT #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{fineAmount}, COALESCE(#{renewCount}, 0) FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM borrow_record br WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.book_id = #{bookId} AND br.status = 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT br.* FROM borrow_record br WHERE br.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record br WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record br WHERE br.book_id = #{bookId} AND br.status = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record br WHERE br.user_id IN
#{userId}

SELECT br.*, u.user_name, b.name AS book_name FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE YEAR(br.borrow_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(br.borrow_time) = #{month} ORDER BY br.borrow_time

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record br
LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id
LEFT JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.id

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, COUNT(*) AS overdueCount, COALESCE(SUM(DATEDIFF(NOW(), br.due_date)), 0) AS totalOverdueDays FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.id WHERE br.status = 0 AND br.due_date < NOW() GROUP BY u.id, u.user_name ORDER BY totalOverdueDays DESC

SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.name AS bookName, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT br.id AS recordId, br.user_id AS userId, br.book_id AS bookId, br.due_date AS dueDate, u.user_email AS userEmail, u.user_name AS userName, b.name AS bookName FROM borrow_record br JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.id JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.status = 0 AND br.due_reminder_sent_time IS NULL AND br.due_date >= #{startTime} AND br.due_date < #{endTime}
